title: Uncapped count loop in batchMint
description: for (uint256 i; i < count; ++i) with count a fully caller-supplied uint256 and no MAX_COUNT ceiling; each iteration is an external mint call.
impact: None to third parties. A large count exceeds the block gas limit and reverts the caller's own transaction (self-DoS). Per-iteration mint cost is the intended economic friction for the nudge gate, so impact is bounded to gas-griefing the caller's own tx.
attackPath: 1. Caller passes an oversized count; their own tx runs out of gas and reverts. No third party is affected; no funds at risk.
recommendation: Introduce a MAX_COUNT ceiling and revert early with a clear error for oversized batches.
